I understood that she was focusing with me because it happens a lot. But I soon realized she was looking at the computer we share. I lost my temper and left before I can finish what I wanted to show her. She apologized and I didn't forgive her. I am planning to forgive her once I post this text, but I just wanted to know if I was the A-hole.
